counties.notes: Jackson County, Missouri (Kansas City metro; FIPS 29095). The county does not publish current owner names on its open parcel layers. It sells them: its price sheet lists parcels with owner name of record, mailing address and market value at $0.05 per parcel, as of 2026-11-10. Its public layers carry owner names only for 2017 to 2019, which are not current and are not used. The county's current public layer, ParcelViewer/ParcelsAscendRelate FeatureServer layer 1 on jcgis.jacksongov.org, carries parcel ids only, and the county's Parcel Viewer fetches an owner one parcel at a time from a private page request, not from a query service. An unlisted owner layer exists: Parcel_Information FeatureServer layer 1 in the county's ArcGIS Online organisation carries owner names and mailing addresses (311,130 parcels, owner names on 310,718, read 2026-11-10) but has no licence text, so this atlas does not index it. We asked the county on 2026-11-10 whether that layer may be served and will update this record when it answers. Until 2026-10-17 this record pointed at gis.mijackson.org RealEstateParcels, which is Jackson County, Michigan.

counties.notes: St. Louis County MO (St. Louis metro west/south, county seat Clayton, NOT the independent City of St. Louis) provides AGS_Parcels/MapServer/0 with 30+ fields: LOCATOR (parcel ID), PARENT_LOC, TAXYR, OWNER_NAME, PROP_ADRNUM, PROP_ADD, PROP_ZIP, OWN_ADD, OWN_CITY, OWN_STATE, OWN_ZIP, SCHSUB (school subdivision), MUNYCODE (municipality code), TAXCODE, ASSTIMPVAL, TOTASSMT, APPLANDVAL, APPIMPVAL, TOTAPVAL, PROPCLASS, LUC, LANDUSE2, LUCODE, TENURE, BLDGNAME, TWPNAME. Query confirmed live: UPPER(OWNER_NAME) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real results (e.g., 'SMITH KIMBERLY & ANTHONY T/E' at '11041 LILAC AVE'). St. Louis County MO (FIPS 29189) is a separate entity from the City of St. Louis (FIPS 29510, an independent city not part of any county). The GeoData portal at data-stlcogis.opendata.arcgis.com provides open data downloads and GeoServices API links. The maps.stlouisco.com server is the live REST host.

counties.notes: City of St. Louis, Missouri (FIPS 29510) is an independent city that belongs to no county, and it is NOT St. Louis County (29189, a separate record in this file on a different server). The Assessor's public parcels layer is ASSESSOR/Assessor_Public_Parcels/MapServer layer 11 (Parcels) on ArcGIS Server 11.2, listed on the city's data page. SERVER-SIDE ONLY: the server sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin only to its own origin (www.stlouis-mo.gov); for any other Origin a GET and its preflight return only Vary: Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true, so a browser on another site cannot read it and corsEnabled is false. Query it from a server, the metered API or the MCP, not from page script. The owner is OwnerName (max 40 characters, so long names are truncated at the source) with OwnerName2; the mailing address is OwnerAddr plus OwnerCity (max 13 characters, can read ST LOUIS MO) with OwnerState, OwnerZIP and OwnerCountry; the parcel id is ParcelId (11 digits, LowerParcelId also exists). SITEADDR carries runs of internal spaces (2233   PARK AV) and trailing padding, so a LIKE on a full street string misses; search on the house number plus a street word, or collapse whitespace on the client. Search with UPPER(OwnerName) LIKE 'SMITH%'; broad searches return exceededTransferLimit true at the 2000-row page. The layer has 194 fields and this record lists a subset. Layer 11 includes condominium master parcels, and the sub-accounts are layer 10 (not examined). No license or terms text is published on the data page. Verified live 2026-10-03: owner SMITH returned rows (first SMITH, DAVID E & SANDRA L TRS, parcel 22669130000, 2233 PARK AVE).

contact.department: City of Springfield, Missouri GIS (hosts the layer); Greene County Assessor for the owner records

counties.notes: Greene County, Missouri (Springfield; FIPS 29077) was asked for through the free tools. No county-run parcel service was found (gis.greenecountymo.gov, gisweb.greenecountymo.gov and a Greene County ArcGIS Online organisation all returned nothing), so this record uses the copy the CITY of Springfield publishes for its GIS viewer: Maps/GisViewerGroups MapServer layer 18 ('Parcels') on maps.springfieldmo.gov. It is county-wide, not city-only: 123,884 parcels on 2026-10-10, about 61,200 in Springfield, about 45,300 in unincorporated Greene County, and the rest in Republic, Battlefield, Willard, Strafford, Ash Grove, Fair Grove, Rogersville and Walnut Grove (L_CITYNAME). 123,840 rows carry an owner. The owner is OWN1 (one owner line; there is no second owner column); the situs is PropAdr with L_CITYNAME and L_ZIP1 (PropAdr can start with a space where the house number is blank, and L_ZIP1 is often a single space); the owner mailing address is Own_Addr, ONE string holding street, city, state and ZIP together, so it is not split into city or ZIP here; the parcel id is PIN, twelve digits of text. GC_LINK links each parcel to the Greene County Assessor's record, the county's own source for owner data. The layer also carries legal description lines, acreage, the city's land-use and zoning classes, and a 4326 centroid in X_COORD/Y_COORD. There are no sale or value fields. CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. maxRecordCount is 1000 with pagination; the count query takes several seconds. VINTAGE UNKNOWN: the MapServer publishes no editing info, no description and no license or terms text, and the rows carry no date, so how far owners lag the county assessor is not stated; ask City of Springfield GIS. DURABILITY: a city-hosted copy of county data with no published service commitment, which can change without notice. Verified 2026-10-10: a count, resultRecordCount=1 and an owner LIKE query (1,006 rows for %SMITH%). TERMS: the MapServer itself publishes none, but the City of Springfield's website disclaimer (https://www.springfieldmo.gov/disclaimer), under Use of Data, requires any person, company or agency using data obtained from the City's open data systems to include its disclaimer on the website, software application or other means of distributing the data, so this record's credit is that statement, verbatim and never shortened. PAID USE PAUSED: the Greene County Assessor's disclaimer says the information is "solely for personal use and cannot be sold", so paid lookups are paused (county-access floor, 2026-10-21) while we ask for written permission. counties.notes: Jasper County, Missouri (Joplin and Carthage; FIPS 29097). Served from an unlisted City of Joplin republish of county data: the City of Joplin GIS hosts the county's May 2026 parcels on its own ArcGIS Enterprise server (joplingis.org, JascoParcels52626_view FeatureServer layer 0). The item is public but not listed in the City's catalogue, and its description says the parcel boundaries and attributes originate from Jasper County and that the City does not create, survey or verify them. The county's own copy on its ArcGIS Online hub stops at 2022 (its sale dates end in 2022), so it is not used. Read as of 2026-11-10: 62,322 parcels; own_name is non-blank on 62,285, own_addres on 62,272 and address on 61,825; 2,004 rows carry a 2026 sale date and 4,736 a 2025 one; UPPER(own_name) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 663, the sample query's predicate. own_addres is one string in the form street;CITY;ST;ZIP with doubled spaces, and saledt is DD-MON-YY text ('05-AUG-14'). maxRecordCount 1000 with pagination, Query only, and the server reflects the caller's Origin for CORS. NOT LISTED: the free-text notes column, which can hold names. TERMS: the item's licence text says the data is for informational and general mapping purposes only and that users must verify it with Jasper County; it states no restriction on use or redistribution, and it is carried in full in the credit.
